Magic Johnson

Earvin Johnson Jr.

(Magic, Buck, E.J. the Deejay, Tragic, The Magic Man, Junior)

Position: Point Guard, Shooting Guard, and Power Forward ▪ Shoots: Right

6-9, 215lb (206cm, 97kg)

Born: August 14, 1959 in Lansing, Michigan us

College: Michigan State

High School: Everett in Lansing, Michigan

Draft: Los Angeles Lakers, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 1979 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: October 12, 1979

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2002 (Full List)

Career Length: 13 years

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Magic Johnson?

Magic Johnson is 66 years old.

Where was Magic Johnson born?

Magic Johnson was born in Lansing, Michigan.

When was Magic Johnson born?

Magic Johnson was born on August 14, 1959.

How tall is Magic Johnson?

Magic Johnson is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

How much did Magic Johnson weigh when playing?

Magic Johnson weighed 215 lbs (97 kg) when playing.

Is Magic Johnson in the Hall of Fame?

Magic Johnson was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2002 (Full List) .

When was Magic Johnson drafted?

Magic Johnson was drafted by Los Angeles Lakers, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 1979 NBA Draft.

What position did Magic Johnson play?

Point Guard, Shooting Guard, and Power Forward.

When did Magic Johnson retire?

Magic Johnson last played in 1996.

What is Magic Johnson's net worth?

Magic Johnson made at least $39,342,860 playing professional basketball.

How much did Magic Johnson make?

Magic Johnson made $3,142,860 in 1989.

What did Magic Johnson average?

Magic Johnson averaged 19.5 points, 7.2 rebounds, and 11.2 assists per game.

How many rings does Magic Johnson have?

Magic Johnson won 5 championships.

What schools did Magic Johnson attend?

Magic Johnson attended Everett in Lansing, Michigan and Michigan State.

What are Magic Johnson's nicknames?

Magic, Buck, E.J. the Deejay, Tragic, The Magic Man, Junior are nicknames for Magic Johnson.
